verdict.rationale: The CLI can write Ultrametric instruction and skill files into a project for Codex and Claude Code, via `init` with a dry-run preview. Any agent host that supports remote MCP can connect to the hosted server, and the docs give guidance on when to use the CLI versus MCP. Work carries across agents through shared hosted records. Missing for 10: per-harness instructions for Cursor or other agents beyond Codex and Claude Code, documentation of how the generated files differ per harness, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
